content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Core business is electric power generation alongside telecom; the target has no power business and is purely communications."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Software and outsourced IT vendor to telecom operators, not a network connectivity provider selling service to households."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Mainly mobile wireless and international island markets; rural fixed broadband is secondary to its wireless business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Billboard advertising and insurance brokerage make up most of the business; broadband is a minor separate segment."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Long distance and VoIP calling only, with no owned fiber broadband, video or rural local telephone network."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone software and web hosting sold to small businesses, not facilities-based rural residential connectivity."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Local newspaper publisher selling advertising and subscriptions; no telecommunications or network business."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Rural incumbent telco selling broadband, voice, video and business communications over its own local fiber network."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells communications hardware and software to carriers and enterprises; does not sell connectivity to end customers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Cloud communications software subscriptions sold to businesses; no owned network or residential broadband."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Rural and small-town wireline broadband, home phone, video and business connectivity over owned networks, though wireless is large."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Primarily leases fiber and copper network capacity to carriers; retail rural broadband is a secondary business."}]}
